provenance: Rule-computed candidates on the PRODUCTION model (3D_model_prep/OmniAnt_25PCs_joint_limited.pkl, 10235 verts), the model every fitted result in this project uses. v0.1 of this file was built on SMIL_OmniAnt.pkl (10229 verts) because that is what config.SMAL_FILE names; measure.py line 52 overrides it via SMILIFY_SMAL_FILE and the two topologies are incompatible, so every v0.1 index was void. Validated by validate_landmarks.py. NOT anatomically adjudicated: the validator checks geometry and part membership, it cannot confirm a point is the structure it is named after. Landmarks with source='verify' require expert review before publication.

clypeal_margin_ant_mid.note: Anteriormost midline point of the head part. GLAD HL anterior endpoint. Verify it sits on the median clypeal margin, not on a mandible or the labrum.

cephalic_margin_post_mid.note: Posteriormost midline point of the head part. GLAD HL posterior endpoint. Verify it is the occipital margin midpoint, not inside the neck/foramen.

mandibular_apex_r.note: Vertex furthest from the mandibular articulation = the apical tooth. HIGHEST-RISK point: the template is a mean mandible, and correspondence on trap-jaw (Odontomachus) and long-mandible (Aenictus) forms may not hold.

antennal_insertion_r.note: Head vertex nearest the scape articulation. Torular/antennal insertion.

scape_apex_r.note: Furthest scape vertex from its articulation. NOTE: GLAD SL excludes the basal condyle/neck, so the proximal endpoint is the articulation, not the bulb.

wl_anterior_r.note: Anteriormost mesosoma vertex in the right lateral band -- the front of the pronotum in profile, excluding the neck. Type III constructed.

wl_posterior_r.note: Posteroventral-most mesosoma vertex in the same lateral band -- the posterior basal angle of the metapleuron, behind and below the hind coxa. Type III.

petiole_ant_mid.note: Anterior petiole, VENTRAL midline outline (same-surface rule).

gaster_apex_mid.note: Posteriormost midline gaster point (TBL endpoint). Taken over b_a_3+b_a_4 because b_a_5 carries no vertices.
